newsitem.title: UK: IPE gas oil end down, pulled by U.S. in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: IPE gas oil end down, pulled by U.S. in thin trade.

text.p: IPE gas oil closed lower on Wednesday, having been pulled down by NYMEX heating oil in thin volumes, brokers said.
"It's been a quiet day, basically mirroring heating oil," said one broker.
Jan gas oil closed $219.25 a tonne, down $2.75 on the day after a brief spurt to the upside took the contract to a session high of $222.75.
"The volumes have been a let down. We've basically been toyed with by the U.S," said a dealer.
Brokers said that some players were reluctant to take positions in such a volatile market.
"There's been a distinct lack of quality paper. In some cases management might have given orders to play down risk because the market is so erratic," said one.
Brokers noted that colder weather -- the driver behind distillates' strength on both sides of the Atlantic -- had not yet materialised in Europe.
Feb Brent also shed earlier gains, but had bounced off lows to trade 32 cents down at $23.38 a barrel at 1753 GMT.
